evidence.title: Update authentication middleware logic
evidence.content: Refactored JWT validation to use strict audience checking. Committer: s-tiwari

evidence.title: Deployment of payment-api v1.4.2
evidence.content: Deployment completed successfully to production cluster.

evidence.title: Spike in 401 Unauthorized responses
evidence.content: Payment API returning 401 for 80% of requests originating from the legacy checkout service.

evidence.title: High Authentication Failure Rate
evidence.content: Alert triggered: Authentication failure rate exceeded 50% threshold on payment-api.

evidence.title: Previous JWT audience mismatch incident
evidence.content: In INC-2025-08, strict audience checking caused failures for legacy clients that did not send the 'aud' claim in JWTs.
